L0: every block's output under the line (one column = one frame = 8 px of the line). L2: hover or tap a reference character to see its occlusion profile (solid: drop of its score when a 16 px window over the line is blanked) and gradient × input (dashed), with the CTC run centre (tick) and the occlusion peak (dot). Shown: the first six sampled lines read at CER ≤ 20 %.
